title: Total RNA Extraction Protocol for Marine Ostracods
author: Lisa Mesrop

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Samples
steps.instruction: Bring necessary reagents and samples to the required temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Remove RNA AMPure XP magnetic beads from the fridge and allow to reach room temperature for 30 minutes.
(Optional) Remove Proteinase K aliquot (stock 20 mg/ml) from the freezer and allow to reach room temperature.
Remove RNA samples from the -80°C freezer and thaw on ice (approximately 5 minutes).

steps.title: Optional Proteinase K Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat samples with Proteinase K if required.

substeps.instruction: (Optional) Add Proteinase K to each sample to achieve a final concentration of 2 mg/mL.
Pipette up and down at least 3 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 - 30 minutes.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Optional Homogenization
steps.instruction: Collect sample liquid and perform optional ceramic bead homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Spin RNA samples for a few seconds to collect liquid at the bottom of the tube.
(Optional) Dispense a few microliters of ceramic beads into each sample and vortex at max speed for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
(Optional) Use a 20 µL pipette to carefully remove all liquid from the ceramic beads and transfer into a new labeled tube for each sample.
Measure the exact amount of liquid removed.
Spin tubes briefly to collect remaining liquid and discard tubes containing ceramic beads.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Mix samples with AMPure XP beads to bind RNA.

substeps.instruction: Measure the volume of each sample and multiply by 1.8 to determine the required volume of RNA AMPure XP magnetic beads.
If beads have been sitting out for a long time, vortex them at maximum speed for 2 minutes.
Thoroughly mix each sample by slowly pipetting the entire volume up and down 10-15x.
Incubate samples with RNA AMPure XP magnetic beads for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Separate beads from supernatant and wash with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Place sample tubes on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes, or until the supernatant is clear.
Prepare fresh 80% ethanol.
Carefully remove and discard the clear supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Add 200 µL of 80% ethanol to each tube and let sit for 2 minutes.
Repeat the magnetic separation and ethanol wash steps (Steps 16 and 17) once more.

steps.title: Dry Beads
steps.instruction: Dry the bead pellet before elution.

substeps.instruction: Let the magnetic beads dry with the tube cap open for no more than 8 minutes.
Ensure beads do not crack; they should appear matte in texture when ready.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Release RNA from the beads using elution water and inhibitor.

substeps.instruction: Prepare elution water (RNase- and DNase-free, filtered) and SUPERase RNase Inhibitor (prepared with RNase- and DNase-free, filtered water).
Add elution water over the bead pellet and carefully pipette up and down at least 20x until beads are fully resuspended.
Incubate samples for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Place samples back on the magnetic stand for 5 to 10 minutes, or until the elution water is clear.
Carefully collect the elute and transfer it into a new tube.
Place samples on ice immediately to preserve RNA integrity.

steps.title: Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR-clean workstation and lab area.
